faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VNIT Training and Placement Manager position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Training and Placement Manager position at VNIT is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation in engineering along with an MBA from a recognized university to be eligible for the Training and Placement Manager role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the Training and Placement Manager position?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, three years of relevant experience in a reputed institute is considered desirable for the Training and Placement Manager post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Training and Placement Manager role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Training and Placement Manager position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Training and Placement Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Training and Placement Manager position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the VNIT Training and Placement Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application with all required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Training and Placement Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Training and Placement Manager position involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Training and Placement Manager position at VNIT is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.
